title: Session Handoff Conversion Protocol

canonical_node.axiom: A session handoff must be converted into a machine-ingest manifest and a human-readable startup summary, preserving the three-layer structure.
definitions: Machine-ingest manifest: structured output that another AI can use immediately.
Human-readable startup summary: a summary that a human can use to start the next session.
Three-layer structure: Session Manifest, Decisions and Results, Open Threads.
derivation: The dropped page is split into a machine-ingest manifest and a startup summary.
The parser trusts the three-layer structure.
If the dropped page is freeform or missing layer headers, outputs will be thinner and should be reviewed once.
canonical_node.action: Convert dropped session pages into a machine-ingest manifest and a human-readable startup summary, following the three-layer structure.
boundary: Does not guarantee correct parsing of freeform or missing-layer-header pages.
Does not wire the vectorization pipeline into the vector store.
Does not embed session manifests into Qdrant.
test: Check that the output contains a machine-ingest manifest and a human-readable startup summary.
Check that the three-layer structure is preserved when the source page has the expected headers.
Check that the output is usable by another AI immediately.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a repeatable workflow for converting dropped session pages into structured handoff outputs.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the ability to start the next session from a generated summary instead of raw chat history.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this, dropped session pages remain unstructured and harder for another AI to use immediately.

overstatement_risks: Claims that the pipeline works may overstate reliability without formal verification.
Claims that NotebookLM calls work machine-verified are not substantiated.
kill_conditions: If the source page is freeform and the parser fails, the protocol may not hold.
If the vectorization pipeline is required for the protocol to be useful, the protocol is incomplete.
risk.lean_target: Convert dropped session pages into structured handoff outputs with minimal assumptions.

plain_summary: This document describes a workflow for converting dropped session pages into a machine-ingest manifest and a human-readable startup summary. It is a narrative anchor for a local handoff process, not a formal proof.
